scope: First clean native success in recorded order, or the first native launch attempt when no success exists; diagnostic repetitions are separate from tournament gates. Policies, formations, engine and configuration are unchanged.

telemetry.scope: Raw native observations; command ticks are not executions. Wall contacts require the reflected native position and velocity, with no intervening touch. Goals are attributed only to an uninterrupted confirmed rebound shot.
